_help.note: Default session settings. On first launch this is copied to ~/.heliograph/session.json. Edit live in-app with 'E'; SAVE writes your copy there. This file is the factory default and ships with the app.
_help.recDir: folder for recordings — "" means the OS videos folder (macOS ~/Movies, Linux ~/Videos, Windows %USERPROFILE%\Videos). Recordings always go into a HelioRecordings/ subfolder. Set it via E -> Recordings.
_help.coordinates: auto-generated each launch (waypoint + heading); distance counts recorded seconds
